thread:
alex_sales: Quick note from this morning's Orbis demo — their web client throws `Unexpected end of JSON input` when streaming. They cut the demo short.

tariq_se: Yikes. Can we get the raw fragment or HAR? Cc @eve_eng

alex_sales: They pasted: `data: {"choices":[{"text":"Launch pla` — looks cut before the closing braces and missing event boundary.

eve_eng: That pattern usually means an intermediary (proxy/edge) closed the connection mid-chunk. Any info on their edge?

maya_cs: Orbis says they have an internal edge that enforces a 5s write idle timeout and rewrites Connection headers.

tariq_se: Two-track approach: (1) hotfix SDK to buffer until a full SSE event or successful JSON.parse (fast); (2) recommend their ops change: disable proxy buffering, bump proxy_read_timeout to 30s, and let Transfer-Encoding pass through (medium).

eve_eng: I checked our logs for session orbis-2182: we see an initial write then a second small write; upstream returned `502` during the tail write. I can reproduce by simulating nginx with short proxy_read_timeout.

ops-bot: Created ticket INC-9954 assigned to eve_eng: Investigate Orbis SSE truncation.

alex_sales: Can we get a one-paragraph security note for their reviewers about SSE vs websockets and required headers? They asked on the call.

maya_cs: On it — will include TLS requirements, origin checks, and headers to preserve.

tariq_se: I'll prepare the SDK patch and a short example showing buffering until `

` boundary then parse. Ship as 0.5.1-orbis-hotfix.

alex_sales: Scheduling pairing with Orbis devs at 16:30 PT to test the patch. Please post HAR and outcome here.

eve_eng: Will update after pairing. Thanks.
